Construction of hot and cold clusters for HNSCC-based CD8 + T cell infiltration-related scores and identification of significant CD8 + T cell infiltration-related genes indicated prognosis in HNSCC

(A) Univariate Cox regression analysis revealed that 33 CD8 + T cell infiltration-related genes were significantly correlated with prognosis. (B) Two-CD8 + T cell-related molecular clusters were identified using NMF clustering analysis. (C) The PCA analysis of distinct CD8 + T cell-related molecular clusters. (D) Kaplan-Meier curves showing the difference in overall survival between hot and cold cluster tumors. (E) The heatmap of clinical TNM stages and HPV status between hot and cold cluster tumors. (F) Volcano plot-based DEGs between cluster hot and cold tumors. (G) Heatmap of the relationship between ESTIMATE scores, GSVA, and different cohorts of the two clusters. (H and I) The biological functions based on GO and KEGG enrichment analyses and GSVA between hot and cold cluster tumors. (J) Differences in the pathways-based GSVA between the two clusters. (K-M) Differences in the expression of immune-infiltrating cells and immune-related functions based on ssGSEA (K and L) and CIBERSORT (M) between the two clusters. ∗ p < 0.05; ∗∗ p < 0.01; ∗∗∗ p < 0.001; ∗∗∗∗ p < 0.0001. (N) Flower plot showing overlapping genes (OLR1, SNAPC1, and CLEC10A) based on eight machine learning algorithms. (O-T) Importance of OLR1, SNAPC1, and CLEC10A was assessed using different algorithms. (U) Real-time-qPCR analysis of OLR-1, SNAPC1, and CLEC10A mRNA expression in normal and tumor tissues.
